description: This Java class 'PcChargeServices' provides services for interacting with GoSoftware's PCCharge payment gateway, including credit card authorization, capture, release (void), and refund transactions. It includes methods for setting up the API, handling credit card info, and executing various payment operations within an OFBiz framework context.

classes.name: PcChargeServices
classes.description: Service class providing payment operations (authorization, capture, release, refund) for GoSoftware's PCCharge gateway within OFBiz.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization by configuring the PCCharge API and sending a transaction, returning success or error details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction identified by a stored reference number.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a pre-authorized transaction, effectively canceling it.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured transaction, identified via the authorization reference.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Populates the PCCharge API with credit card details extracted from context.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Constructs and returns a PcChargeApi object configured with properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds properties required to configure the PCCharge API from context and entity properties.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount to a string with proper scale and rounding.
